title: ctaudit / WAF report
description: The ctaudit WAF HTML report rebuilt from the request and finding lines ctaudit ships to Loki (--loki, or serve waf). Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time; lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time, so the range must then cover the scan runs.

list.name: client_ip
list.label: Client IP (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the client IP.

panels.title: Requests

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range]))

panels.description: WAF-inspected requests in the time range that match the job, web ACL, action, and client IP filters. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Blocked

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action="BLOCK" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests with a BLOCK action.

panels.title: Allowed

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action="ALLOW" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests with an ALLOW action.

panels.title: Counted

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | json cr="count_rules" | cr!="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests with a COUNT action; these would block if the rule were switched to BLOCK.

panels.title: Challenged

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action=~"CAPTCHA|CHALLENGE" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests with a CAPTCHA or CHALLENGE action.

panels.title: Block rate

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action="BLOCK" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range]))

panels.description: Blocked share of matching requests. Orange from 1%, red from 5%. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Web ACLs

targets.expr: count(sum by (acl) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct web ACLs that inspected matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests by action

targets.expr: sum by (action) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Findings (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="finding"}

panels.description: Findings do not carry an acl or action label, so this table ignores those filters. Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the finding's request time; lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time.

panels.title: Terminating rules (non-ALLOW)

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (rule) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json rule="rule", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action!="ALLOW" | rule!="" | keep rule [$__range])))

panels.description: Terminating rules of non-ALLOW requests, ranked by hits. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Rule groups

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (rule_group) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json rule_group="rule_group", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | rule_group!="" | keep rule_group [$__range])))

panels.description: Managed or custom rule groups that inspected the most requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top blocked client IPs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action="BLOCK" | client_ip!="" | keep client_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Client IPs with the most BLOCK actions. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Blocked countries

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (country) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json country="country", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | action="BLOCK" | country!="" | keep country [$__range])))

panels.description: Two-letter countries with the most BLOCK actions. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Actions by source

targets.expr: sum by (source) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json source="source", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | source!="" | keep source [$__range]))

panels.description: Share of matching requests by inspection source (WAF, CloudFront, or an App Runner/AppSync/Cognito/Verified Access source). Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top client IPs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | client_ip!="" | keep client_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Client IPs that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Countries

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (country) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json country="country", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | country!="" | keep country [$__range])))

panels.description: Two-letter country codes that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: JA4 fingerprints

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (ja4) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json ja4="ja4", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | ja4!="" | keep ja4 [$__range])))

panels.description: TLS client fingerprints (JA4) seen on the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: User agents

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json user_agent="user_agent", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | user_agent!="" | keep user_agent [$__range])))

panels.description: User-Agent headers that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Hosts

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (host) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json host="host", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | host!="" | keep host [$__range])))

panels.description: Host headers of matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: URIs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (uri) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json uri="uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | label_format uri=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .uri "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | uri!="" | keep uri [$__range])))

panels.description: Most requested URIs. Numeric path segments become {n} so IDs group together. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Methods

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (method) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json method="method", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | method!="" | keep method [$__range])))

panels.description: Matching requests by HTTP method. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Response codes

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (response_code) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json response_code="response_code", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | response_code!="" | keep response_code [$__range])))

panels.description: Custom response codes WAF sent for a CAPTCHA or CHALLENGE action, when set. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="waf", kind="request", acl=~"$acl", action=~"$action"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip"

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.
